# Stage Tales — G4 background unicorn

“Stage Tales” is a *fan-used name* for a golden-brown (gamboge) unicorn stallion among Twilight Sparkle’s School of Friendship students in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for his pale mint-turquoise mane and tail, blue eyes, and **comedy-and-tragedy theater-mask cutie mark**. He is recognizable as one of the recurring school-background ponies, rather than as a lead with a personal storyline. [Character listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies).

**Name and identity.** The pony appears in the official G4 television continuity, but *Stage Tales* is not verified as an official on-screen, merchandise, or credit name. A fanfiction author used the name in December 2018 and said their names for otherwise unnamed School of Friendship students came from Reddit; the originating naming post is unverified. The mask symbol is also used by **On Stage**, the Manehattan theater pony, but that does *not* establish they are the same character. No alter ego or stage identity is verified. [Contemporary fan naming note](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/428203/3/high-seas-of-adventure/chapter-2-chase-through-the-mists) · [On Stage comparison](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Method_Mares).

**Speaking and appearances.** No individual spoken line or voice actor is reliably attributed to Stage Tales in the show. His identified background appearances begin with *School Daze* (S8E1–2) and include *A Rockhoof and a Hard Place* (S8E21), *School Raze – Part 2* (S8E26), several more season-eight/nine school scenes, *My Little Pony Best Gift Ever*, and *The Last Problem* (S9E26). Fanfiction dialogue using the name belongs to that fan-created story, not the television continuity.

## Important moments

Stage Tales has **no verified solo, dialogue-driven, or outcome-changing scene**; the meaningful moments below concern the school community in which he appears, not deeds attributed to him.

1. **A new student body — “School Daze – Part 1” (S8E1).** Twilight opens her school to students from different backgrounds, establishing Stage Tales’s recurring setting. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E623gv21YAU). *Scene timestamp unavailable.*
2. **The school returns on its own terms — “School Daze – Part 2” (S8E2).** Twilight rejects the restrictive accreditation rules and restores the inclusive school that he attends. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F3iK6yjcnOY). *Scene timestamp unavailable.*
3. **The school survives Cozy Glow — “School Raze – Part 2” (S8E26).** The Young Six stop the takeover threatening their classmates; Stage Tales is a background student, not an identified hero of the rescue. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tq1XDOT8Q3k). *Scene timestamp unavailable.*
